description: Prakiraan cuaca BMKG per kelurahan/desa (per 3 jam, hingga 3 hari): kondisi, suhu, kelembapan, angin, tutupan awan. Needs the Kemendagri village code "adm4" (format 00.00.00.0000, e.g. 31.71.03.1001 = Kemayoran, Jakarta Pusat). BMKG weather forecast for an Indonesian village, 3-hourly for up to 3 days. Free, no key.

days.description: How many calendar days to return (1-3), counted from the first forecast date (today, local time). Default 3.

name: prakiraan_cuaca
title: Prakiraan cuaca / Weather forecast
